Name: Abigail and Juliet Prank the JojaMart
Author: zoedoll
TagLine: Abigail wants to sabotage the JojaMart, but she can't do it alone... 4 events for Abigail and Juliet (custom NPC). Available in English, Spanish and Chinese.
Description:
****Updated for 1.6 by [Airyn](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS)!**

**Due to IRL stuff I am on a modding hiatus - I have enough time to answer comments and upload bugfixes or updates that other people give me, but not to update mods myself or add new features. While most of my mods should remain compatible with 1.6 there may be some issues I won't be able to address until I have time to mod again.****

Abigail wants to sabotage the JojaMart, but she can't do it alone...

This mod contains 4 new events for Abigail and [Juliet](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398)!

**Event One:**
Requires 2 hearts with Abigail. Go to the Saloon on a rainy afternoon.

**Event Two:**
Requires 2 hearts with Juliet. Go to Pierre's shop on a Sunday when Juliet is there.

**Event Three:**
Go to the JojaMart while Juliet is working, but not on a Monday or a Wednesday.

**Event Four:**
Go to town after 8pm.
**_Translations:_**

*   Spanish by Deepeace

*   Chinese by Lizecheng01
Thank you [Lemurkat](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657) for letting me use Juliet, and to the Stardew modding discord for putting up with all my questions! This mod is all set up with i18n tokens for ease of translations, if you want to translate it just let me know!
